title: Cozy Orthographic
description: Un style d'illustration numérique 2D chaleureux, caractérisé par des contours sombres épais et irréguliers et des aplats de couleurs. Il présente une perspective pseudo-isométrique, un ombrage minimaliste et une finition nette rappelant les jeux indépendants.
description_en: A wholesome digital 2D illustration style characterized by thick, irregular dark outlines and flat color fills. It features a pseudo-isometric perspective, minimalistic cel-shading, and a clean, untextured finish reminiscent of indie games.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration numérique 2D chaleureux, caractérisé par des contours sombres épais et irréguliers et des aplats de couleurs. Il présente une perspective pseudo-isométrique, un ombrage minimaliste et une finition nette rappelant les jeux indépendants.
prompt: Digital 2D illustration, cozy indie game aesthetic, defined by thick, chunky dark outlines and crisp flat color fills. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The rendering technique relies on clean, untextured vector-like shapes with absolute zero grain, noise, or canvas texture. Lighting is uniformly flat, utilizing minimalistic, hard-edged cel-shaded drop shadows to establish depth rather than complex gradients or volumetric light. Color science revolves around a muted, earthy harmony, deploying vibrant {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}} as foundational tones, punctuated by vivid pops of {{accent_color}}. Internal contours feature thinner, brightly colored strokes to denote specific material highlights, such as glossy or transparent surfaces. The spatial dynamics employ a pseudo-isometric or orthographic perspective, stacking elements vertically and diagonally to create a diorama-like sense of depth without converging vanishing points. Edges are razor-sharp, strictly contained within bold, slightly wobbly ink-like perimeters that give a hand-drawn yet digital feel. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. digital illustration, thick outlines, flat colors, indie game art, cel-shaded, orthographic, wholesome, diorama, crisp vectors, bold ink, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame
